Whole-book custody is mixed: onchain lending positions are heavily concentrated in Coinbase-custodied borrower collateral (cbBTC 90.86% and cbETH 1.38% of lender assets) alongside onchain WETH (7.40%) and wstETH (0.35%); safeguards of those layers remain unestablished.
